$comment: Derived from the local clone's src/App.jsx section order and src/components/*.jsx, cross-checked against CLONE_SPEC.md and headless QA measurements of the live site. Only the homepage was cloned (deliberate scope); other tines.com routes are linked (mostly as root-relative paths that don't resolve in the clone, a few as absolute tines.com URLs) and are NOT documented here.

meta.source: https://www.tines.com/ (homepage only), as rebuilt in this React + Vite clone

categories.CHROME: Site-wide navigation and footer frame wrapped around page content.
categories.HERO: Top-of-page introduction: headline, primary CTAs and the hero visuals beneath them.
categories.PROOF: Credibility blocks: customer logos and reasons-to-believe cards.
categories.NARRATIVE: Problem/solution storytelling bands that explain the product's positioning.
categories.SHOWCASE: Interactive product showcase that lets the visitor switch between team-specific views.
categories.CONVERSION: Closing call-to-action band that asks for sign-up or a demo.

chrome.site-nav.description: Sticky 68px frosted-pill navbar: Tines logo, Product / Solutions / Discover mega-dropdowns (staggered column entrance), Customers and Pricing links, search, Log in, Book a demo and Sign up. Collapses to a hamburger menu with accordion panels below 1024px. Blur/backdrop layer fades in only when scrolled or a menu is open.
chrome.site-nav.scope: Present on the homepage, the only route in this clone.

hero.intro.description: Hero copy block: 'NEW / Introducing Tines 3B' tag pill linking to the launch, the page H1, a serif byline, and the Book a demo (filled) + Sign up free (frosted) button pair.
hero.intro.scope: Homepage only; the first block inside main.

proof.logo-marquee.description: Horizontally scrolling customer-logo marquee (logo set duplicated, linear at 40px/s, draggable, edge-masked). Contains real third-party trademarks.
proof.logo-marquee.scope: Homepage only, directly under the hero copy.

hero.wordmark-stage.description: Large '100x' flower wordmark stage that sinks with page scroll on wide screens. On the original it is a runtime canvas with drifting drone banners; the clone uses static PNG stand-ins per breakpoint.
hero.wordmark-stage.scope: Homepage only, behind and below the logo marquee.

hero.product-demo.description: Framed product-demo visual (phone / tablet / desktop SVG frames by breakpoint) with a chaptered timeline bar: play/pause, segmented scrubber, caption and elapsed/total time. The original's scripted demo animation is a static frame in the clone; the timeline itself plays.
hero.product-demo.scope: Homepage only; closes the hero region.

narrative.monitor-banner.description: Problem statement band: serif H2 about AI making everyone a builder, set over a retro monitor-wall illustration (runtime canvas on the original, PNG stand-ins in the clone).

narrative.solution-panel.description: Large rounded purple panel answering the problem band: H2, a two-by-two grid of solution items with an orb mascot whose face follows the pointer, a Tines 3B footer with an Explore the product button, and a flower-bed illustration with scroll parallax.
narrative.solution-panel.scope: Homepage only, after the monitor banner.

showcase.use-case-tabs.description: Team use-case showcase: H2, five colour-coded team tabs (IT, Security, Finance, People, Operations) with hover grow and a colour wipe on change, and a Workflow / Frontend toggle swapping between two screenshot frames. Fades up once on scroll into view.
showcase.use-case-tabs.scope: Homepage only, after the solution panel.

proof.why-tines.description: 'Why Tines' reasons-to-believe block: H2 beside a slowly spinning constellation/radar illustration with twinkling stars, followed by four purple cards each with an icon, serif title and short body.
proof.why-tines.scope: Homepage only, after the use-case showcase.

conversion.start-today-cta.description: Closing CTA: giant 'Start today' wordmark (runtime canvas on the original, PNG stand-ins in the clone) that hosts a custom spinning-triangle cursor, a tagline, and Sign up free + Book a demo buttons.
conversion.start-today-cta.scope: Homepage only; the last block inside main.

chrome.site-footer.description: Site footer: five link columns (Product, Solutions, Discover, Company, Trust and security) with thin dividers, an 'Ask AI about Tines' pill with assistant links, copyright and Cookie settings. Becomes a multi-open accordion below 768px.
chrome.site-footer.scope: Present on the homepage, the only route in this clone.
